action_items: No API-bearing criteria in this matrix (static portfolio, no login) - no backend pytest lane required.

checks.name: hero-profile-photo-quality
checks.evidence: profile-photo img loaded (complete=true, naturalWidth>0), portrait crop confirmed (height>width bounding box), and AVAILABLE FOR PKL badge bounding box does not intersect the top 60% (face zone) of the photo box.

checks.name: hero-portfolio-identity
checks.evidence: Rerun persisted check passed: greeting, full name, headline, CTA, profile-image-placeholder frame visible, AVAILABLE FOR PKL and OPEN TO NEW IDEAS badges present and non-overlapping. Only expected ws://localhost:443/ws ingress console noise.

checks.name: sport4all-carousel-desktop
checks.evidence: At 1280px: 4 dot indicators present, counter starts 01/04, next-button advances to 02/04, dot-4 click jumps to 04/04, previous-button returns to 03/04, aria-current tracks active dot; slides 1-4 each confirmed loaded (img.complete && naturalWidth>0).

checks.name: sport4all-carousel-mobile
checks.evidence: At 390x844: carousel bounding box fully within [0,390] on x-axis, document.scrollWidth<=clientWidth (no horizontal overflow) before and after clicking next-button (01/04 -> 02/04), dot-1 click returns to 01/04.

checks.name: project-presentation
checks.evidence: 3 project cards rendered; project-01 now shows project-01-sport4all-carousel (visual-placeholder testid count=0 for 01); project-02 and project-03 still show project-0X-visual-placeholder with 'replaceable visual' caption, confirming intentional staged placeholders.

checks.criterion: Regresi navigasi dan konten - desktop pill nav
checks.name: pill-navigation-anchor-flow
checks.evidence: Rerun persisted check passed: NV monogram, all four desktop nav links, anchor URLs/sections, active-state assertions intact after new assets.

checks.criterion: Regresi navigasi dan konten - mobile nav + project link
checks.name: mobile-navigation-project-flow
checks.evidence: Rerun persisted check passed: desktop links hidden on mobile, hamburger opens menu, Project link navigates to #project, menu closes.

checks.name: about-and-skills-content
checks.evidence: Rerun persisted check passed for RPL/UI/UX copy and Figma, Canva, CapCut, Adobe Illustrator, Lightroom skill groups.

checks.name: contact-actions
checks.evidence: Rerun persisted check passed: email text/mailto link and LinkedIn/GitHub destination links intact.

checks.criterion: Regresi navigasi dan konten - responsive stability
checks.name: responsive-stability
checks.evidence: Rerun persisted mobile check passed: menu usability, project navigation, no horizontal overflow before/after navigation.
